findings.description: When stripping applies, the prompt text is also whitespace-trimmed with .strip(), which the commit title does not mention. A prompt such as "Name: " is passed to input() as "Name:", dropping the separating space.
findings.rationale: Trigger: a prompt ending in a space (e.g. "Name: ") is read while the stream is not a TTY or color is disabled, so should_strip_ansi returns true. Mechanism: strip_ansi(text).strip() removes the trailing space, and the strip() also removes any leading whitespace. Impact: non-interactive or captured output shows "Name:" with no space, a visible change in prompt text beyond ANSI removal.
